questions.q: A wide bottom cylindrical massless plastic container of height $9$ cm has $40$ identical coins inside it and is floating on water with $3$ cm inside the water. If we start putting more of such coins on its lid, it is observed that after $N$ coins are put, its equilibrium changes from stable to unstable. Equilibrium in floating is stable if the geometric center of the submerged portion is above the center of mass of the object). The value of $N$ is closest to
questions.solution:
Let mass of each coin be $m$.

$∴$ Location of center of mass after $N$ coins are kept on lid from bottom of container is

$\dfrac{40m \times 0 + Nm \times 9}{\left(40 + N\right)m} = \dfrac{9N}{40 + N}cm$

Also height of submerged portion after keeping $N$ coins on lid will be, $\dfrac{3\left(40 + N\right)}{40}cm$

$∴$ Equilibrium will just be stable if

$\dfrac{3}{40} \left(40 + N\right)2 = 9N \left(40 + N\right)$

$⇒ 3N^{2} - 480N + 4800 = 0 ⇒ N = 10 . 72

$

questions.q: A proton and an antiproton come close to each other in vacuum such that the distance between them is $10cm.$& Consider the potential energy to be zero at infinity. The velocity at this distance will be:
questions.solution:
Applying mechanical energy conservation
${K}_{i} + {U}_{i} = {K}_{f} + {U}_{f}$
$0 + 0 = \left(\dfrac{1}{2}mv^{2} + \dfrac{1}{2}mv^{2}\right) + \dfrac{k\left({q}_{1}\right)\left({q}_{2}\right)}{r}$
$\left|{q}_{1}\right| = \left|{q}_{2}\right| = e, {q}_{1} = + e$
${q}_{2} = - e$
and $r = 0 . 1m$
$∴ mv^{2} = \dfrac{ke^{2}}{r}$

$∴ v^{2} = \dfrac{ke^{2}}{mr} = \dfrac{9 \times {10}^{9} \times \left(1 . 6 \times {10}^{- 19}\right)2}{\left(1 . 67 \times {10}^{- 27}\right) ( 0 . 1 )}$
$v ≃ 1 . 17m / s$

& Given, potential function for the oscillating particle is

$V\left(x\right) = \left\{\begin{cases}\dfrac{k ( x + a{)}^{2}}{2}, & x 0\end{cases}\right$

So, potential energy of the particle (mass
$m$) is

$U\left(x\right) = \left\{\begin{cases}\dfrac{km ( x + a{)}^{2}}{2}, & x < 0 \\ \dfrac{km ( x - a{)}^{2}}{2}, & x < 0\end{cases}\right$

$\dfrac{dU}{dx} = \left\{\begin{cases}km ( x + a ) , & x 0\end{cases}\right$

If $\dfrac{dU}{dx} = 0,$ when $x = \pm a$

Now, $\dfrac{d^{2}U}{dx^{2}} = km > 0$

So, particle is in unstable equilibrium at $x = \pm a$

Hence, particle is unbounded for $- a > x$ and $x > a$

In region, $- a \le x \le a$, time period of particle reduces from a maximum.
So, correct graph is (b)..
